description: Build a tax-aware rebalancing trade list that brings holdings back to the target model or custom allocation, optionally investing new cash. Sells come from tax-advantaged accounts first, then taxable lots with losses, then the smallest gains; proceeds stay in the account that raised them. Returns each trade (account, symbol, dollars, estimated shares, estimated realized gain and tax), totals, the allocation after the trades, wash-sale and concentration warnings, and notes. Takes the same holdings, prices and target inputs as portfolio_review; missing prices are fetched from live quotes. Trades are estimates for advisor review, not orders.

band.description: Rebalancing band in percentage points (default 5): an asset class further than this from target is out of band.

force.description: Rebalance to target even when every class is within the band (default false).

holdings.description: Holdings as objects, instead of holdingsCsv. Up to 300 rows; one row per lot gives the best tax estimates.

accountType.description: taxable, brokerage, individual, joint, trust, ira, traditional ira, rollover ira, sep ira, 401k, 403b, 457, roth, roth ira, roth 401k, hsa or other. Default taxable.

acquired.description: Date acquired, YYYY-MM-DD; decides short- or long-term gains.

assetClass.description: Optional override: us_equity, intl_equity, bonds, cash or alternatives, or a split such as "us_equity:60;bonds:40". Common ETFs and index funds are classified automatically; unknown tickers count as US stocks.

costBasis.description: Total cost basis of this row in dollars (not per share). Omit when unknown.

shares.description: Number of shares; for CASH, the dollar amount.

symbol.description: Ticker, e.g. VTI. Use CASH for cash balances.

holdingsCsv.description:
Holdings as CSV text in the LunaTerminal import format: a header row with at least symbol and shares; the full header is account,account_type,symbol,shares,cost_basis,asset_class,acquired. cost_basis is the row's total dollars, acquired is YYYY-MM-DD. Example:
account,account_type,symbol,shares,cost_basis,asset_class,acquired
Joint brokerage,taxable,VTI,120,24000,,2021-03-15
Joint brokerage,taxable,AAPL,150,18000,,2019-06-01
Joint brokerage,taxable,CASH,8000,8000,,
Up to 300 rows and 128 KB. Send this or holdings, not both.

model.description: Target model portfolio: conservative (20% stocks), moderately_conservative (40% stocks), moderate (60% stocks), growth (75% stocks), aggressive (90% stocks). Default moderate. risk_profile_score maps a client to one.

newCash.description: New money to invest, in dollars (default 0).

newCashAccount.description: Account name that receives the new cash (default: the first taxable account).

prices.description: Latest price per share by symbol, e.g. {"VTI": 301.25}. CASH and money-market funds are priced at $1. Symbols without a price here are fetched from live quotes.

target.description: Custom target allocation in percent, totalling 100. Use instead of model.

taxRates.description: Capital-gains rates in percent used to estimate tax (default 24 short-term, 15 long-term).

name: rebalance_plan
title: Rebalance plan
